Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.yaml

Class EntityDefinition

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.yaml.EntityDefinition
public class EntityDefinition extends Object
Data class that mirrors the YAML entity definition schema. Populated by SnakeYAML from entity config files in plugins/NoorEntities/entities/.

  • Field Details

    • id

      public String id
      Unique entity id, e.g. "gnome"

    • name

      public EntityDefinition.NameDef name
      name.text / name.color

    • type

      public String type
      Entity type. May be a Bukkit EntityType name ("Humanoid", "ZOMBIE") or a namespaced key like "minecraft:zombie". "Humanoid" maps to MANNEQUIN.

    • xp

      public int xp
      XP dropped on death

    • tier

      public int tier
      Difficulty tier

    • attack_cooldown

      public float attack_cooldown
      Attack cooldown in seconds (also used as shot cooldown for RangedAI)

    • ai_type

      public String ai_type
      AI type.
      • "Hostile" → HostileAI — chases and melees players; aggros via LOS
      • "Neutral" → NeutralAI — only attacks when provoked
      • "Passive" → PassiveAI — flees from nearby players
      • "Ranged" → RangedAI — fires arrows at players with LOS
      • "Default" → base EntityAI (no custom behaviour)
      • Fully-qualified class name for custom AI classes

    • move_speed

      public double move_speed
      Movement speed in blocks per tick. Used by HostileAI, NeutralAI, and PassiveAI. Default: 0.15.

    • aggro_range

      public double aggro_range
      Aggro / detection radius in blocks. HostileAI / NeutralAI / RangedAI: aggro range. PassiveAI: flee range. Default: 16.
